findings.citation_text: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room. Compared to our approach, these works relying on low resolution traffic data due to lower frequencies and packet rates. Also, they require a multi-antenna setup to localize victims and thus result in larger physical footprint compared to mmWave, making the attack more difficult to be carried out in practice.
